item.group_name: Image edits (the user brings a picture)
item.title: Square Crop Keeps Whole Sneaker

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.

item.tests: Tests converting a 16:9 photo to square while preserving the complete subject and its proportions.

answer_sheet.Subject to preserve: The entire white sneaker, including the toe and heel.
answer_sheet.Style, text and other edits: Keep the original photo appearance. No added text or other edits.

must_haves: The sneaker is the same white leather sneaker as in the attachment.
The entire sneaker, including toe, heel and sole, remains visible.
The sneaker has natural proportions, without stretching or squeezing.
The retained floor and background match the source photo, with no added text or decorative elements.

turns.text: Make this wide photo square for an Instagram post. Keep the whole sneaker in view, and don't stretch it or change anything else.
turns.agent:
I couldn’t create the square version because your Magic Hour account has insufficient credits. No image was made.

To keep everything unchanged, place the photo centered on a **square canvas** and add padding above and below—don’t crop or stretch it. A 1080 × 1080 canvas works well for Instagram.

approvals.name: edit_image

style.prompt: Make this wide photograph square ONLY by expanding the canvas above and below the original photograph and seamlessly extending the existing background into the new canvas. Preserve the entire original photograph unchanged in the middle: the whole white sneaker including heel, toe, laces and sole must remain fully visible, exactly the same proportions, appearance, position relative to the original scene, details, color and lighting. No cropping, no stretching, no redesign, no retouching, no object removal, no blur, no change to the sneaker or original background. Extend the gray tabletop below and the existing room background above naturally. Square 1:1 Instagram photo.
